title: Unsafe deserialization of session tokens and settings
difficulty_rationale: Requires replacing pickle with an authenticated JSON format (HMAC, constant-time comparison) and replacing eval() with literal parsing across two functions, while preserving round-trip behaviour.
summary: Session tokens are base64-encoded pickles without integrity protection, and settings values are parsed with eval().
required_behavior: Session tokens are JSON-serialised and authenticated with HMAC-SHA256 using the supplied secret; verification uses a constant-time comparison.
decode_session raises InvalidSession (ValueError subclass) for malformed, tampered, wrongly-signed or legacy pickle tokens, without executing any embedded code.
encode_session raises TypeError for data that is not JSON-serialisable.
parse_settings parses values as Python literals only (numbers, strings, booleans, None, lists, dicts); anything else raises ValueError.

acceptance_tests.description: A crafted pickle token is rejected and its payload never runs.
Changing any character invalidates the token.
Tokens signed with another secret are rejected.
encode_session rejects non-JSON data with TypeError.
